preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM str_rn.accommodation WHERE county = 'Splitsko-dalmatinska'

rollback.sql: UPDATE str_rn.accommodation SET county = REPLACE(county, ' županija', '') WHERE county IN ('Splitsko-dalmatinska županija', 'Istarska županija', 'Primorsko-goranska županija', 'Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija') AND accommodation_id BETWEEN '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222221' AND '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222228';
